We need to build complete retrosynthesis route JSON. We have target molecule? Not given directly. Probably from previous steps: make_3_lvl1-apply_template-1 gave precursors list for applying template to some molecule. The precursors: ["C#C[Si](C)(C)C", "COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1"].

Thus target molecule is the product of that template. We need to retrieve template ID 1914386 and its mapped_rxn. Also need to construct route: root molecule (target) with children reaction node (template_id) and children molecules (precursors). Also need to include maybe further steps? Only level 1? Task name make_3_lvl1-build_complete_route suggests building complete route using level 1 template. So just one reaction step.

We need mapped_rxn for template 1914386. Use get_template to retrieve example reaction, then map_reaction_smiles. Let's call get_template.
